title: Yadanicca4,5,
text: 3 Cakkhum bhikkhave dukkham atītam anāgatam paccuppannam || yaṃ dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || evam etaṃ yathābhutam sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 4-7 Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhā dukkhā || || Kāyo || || 8 Mano dukkho atīto anāgato paccuppanno || || Yam dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama Neso ham asmi na meso attāti || evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || 9 Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
